title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1840: Three marquises fall (1)

section.p: Tiangu was relieved. He was overjoyed.
How fortunate.
This wasn’t a big problem.
He roared, “Attack the Human Realm!”

He noticed that Great Zhou King had departed as well. This was the perfect opportunity for them to attack the Human Realm. The moment Su Yu’s group was forced to return, their offensive would fail. The three marquises could even take the chance to stab them in the back.

Or they could persist in their offensive, but that would give the myriad races the chance to wipe out their Eternals and eliminate the foundation of humanity. Did Su Yu believe that there was only one marquis in the Fate Realm? Was he confident that he could end the battle promptly? What a beautiful dream.

The myriad races moved with a tacit understanding. With Tiangu’s roar, Divine Pseudo Emperor, Phoenix Pseudo Emperor, Nether Pseudo Emperor, Ape Pseudo Emperor, and Celestial Dragon Marquis moved out and started heading toward the Human Realm.
The Fate Realm couldn’t be taken so easily. Everyone knew that two additional ancient marquises had arrived there. Each was strong enough to fight two or even three Daofuses alone.
Perhaps Su Yu’s group would even suffer a defeat before the rest of them needed to do anything. As far as they were concerned, Su Yu was seeking death.
Right at that moment, Su Yu charged forward and roared, “Primordial Giant King, stop Jiwu!”
He had not invited the primordial giants into this operation.

Something felt off about that race. They had seemingly reached a certain agreement with Great Zhou King, but Su Yu had not bothered to ask. He suspected that it was related to Hundred Battle King. Thus, he had not wasted his time with them.
But he wouldn’t mind borrowing their strength if possible. If not, it was no big deal either. It was up to the primordial giants whether they wanted to help.

The various allied races had been rather proactive when working with Su Yu. The primordial giant race was the sole exception. After the previous battle, they had remained in their realm silently. They had not bothered to contact humanity, and Great Zhou King had not proposed further communication with them.

Thus, Su Yu could only view them as a neutral race for now. That shout of his was merely a random attempt to make them fight. He wasn’t too bothered about their choice. As he charged forth, he stabbed his pen forth; his power of dao rippled out.

At the entrance, Fallen Star Marquis and Devilroil Marquis were alarmed. But soon, they rejoiced in the fact that they were right at the entrance instead of inside. They would be in deep trouble if Su Yu were allowed to reach them while they were still being subjected to the suppressive force.
Here, they could leave at any time. They exchanged glances, and they could see that they were both tempted by this opportunity. This was the opportunity to kill Su Yu!

How lucky. Su Yu had actually delivered himself to them. No wonder Fateless had escaped. He must have sensed something. They weren’t even surprised that Fateless was silent about it. This damn race had always been this way.
“Die!”
With a roar, the two charged forth, fully believing that Su Yu was still unaware of their presence. With one punch by Devilroil Marquis, Su Yu’s attack was shattered.
Su Yu’s expression changed drastically. Both Fallen Star Marquis and Devilroil Marquis saw that. Evidently, Su Yu was really unaware that they were there.
“Impossible!” Su Yu roared with desperation, “To me! Now!”
“It’s too late.”

Devilroil Marquis sneered and charged toward Su Yu. He released his incomparably powerful aura. With a smile, Fallen Star Marquis wrapped himself in a thick layer of immortal qi before charging toward Su Yu as well.

At the same time, Abyss Marquis roared, “Fallen Star Marquis and Devilroil Marquis have descended. A large number of experts from the Upper Realm will be here soon. Fate, kunpeng, golden crow, and three-headed demon wolf races. What are you waiting for? The time to purge humanity has arrived.”

This was the best opportunity to wipe out the humans. Their experts had descended from the Upper Realm. These were no ordinary experts. There were ancient marquises. Anyone old enough would be aware of how strong they were.
At the same time.
Projections appeared outside the various ancient realms.
The three heads of an expert from the three-headed demon wolf race looked out with shock and surprise. Had Devilroil Marquis and Fallen Star Marquis descended in advance?

Would Su Yu…really be defeated here? Why had he attacked the Fate Realm? He was simply seeking death. Tiangu and the others were truly devious. They had actually helped two ancient marquises descend in secret.
This was an era where everyone must pick a side. Neutrality did not seem possible anymore.
The three-headed demon wolf race had long reached a decision. They had simply been trying to drag it out as long as possible. But it would be too late to pick a side after humanity was eliminated.
With a roar, the three-headed demon wolf flew out and roared, “Allow me to help the ancient marquises!”
He was making his position clear lest they attack him in confusion. In such a battle, the arrival of someone whose position was unknown was very dangerous.

The three-headed demon wolf was the first to make a choice. He was worried that this would be his final chance to make a choice. If he missed this chance, life might get very difficult for him in the future.
He flew straight toward the Fate Realm. Several experts were already heading toward the Human Realm. He was not needed there.
At the same time, a golden crow wrapped in flames roared, “Block Su Yu’s path of retreat! Seal the place and wipe them out!”
A sea of flames appeared in the sky. The golden crow had entered the battle.
Next, massive waves surged from the Sea of Stars as a massive bird flew out from the sea. The gigantic kunpeng said, “The kunpeng race is here to help against Su Yu!”

All of them had picked a side. The three races viewed this as their final chance to pick a side. The various experts of the myriad races laughed. A strong enemy in front, with the path of retreat severed.
Three ancient marquises in front, and three ancient race Pseudo Emperors behind.
What could Su Yu do now?

Great Zhou King, Su Yu, Hou Pseudo Emperor, Spatial Beast Pseudo Emperor, Book Spirit, and Tea Plant. There were only six of them. Great Zhou King did not seem to be alone, so they could perhaps bump that number to seven.
This might seem like a respectable number, but their combat strength wasn’t sufficient. Each of the three ancient marquises was capable of handling multiple Pseudo Emperors.
Humanity was finished.

Tiangu and many others smiled with satisfaction. There was no escape for Su Yu. The appearance of the two ancient marquises had created a chain reaction, resulting in the addition of three ancient races into their ranks. They weren’t surprised by this.

Su Yu was the one who should be surprised. They reckoned that he would never have imagined that three ancient marquises would be waiting for them there. Even excluding Abyss Marquis, he was faced with five Daofuses, including the ancient races. This seemed even more powerful than the forces the myriad races had mobilized previously.
Su Yu’s expression changed again.
Both Fallen Star Marquis and Devilroil Marquis saw that, and they laughed with amusement. Was he shocked? He was still too young. Was the Fate Realm such an easy realm to attack?

Also, it was only a matter of time before the rest of the ancient races picked their side. And it was very likely that they would pick the myriad races. Was Su Yu feeling very confident before this? Their domination was merely an illusion brought about by the peace.
“Fallen Star, Abyss, stop the others. I will kill this kid myself.”

Devilroil Marquis laughed before throwing countless punches toward Su Yu. With a pen in hand, Su Yu faced the onslaught. Of the many experts, the Spatial Beast Pseudo Emperor was the first to arrive. Instantly, Abyss Marquis charged out to meet him in combat.

Next, June arrived with his gigantic bamboo and joined the battle against Abyss Marquis. Abyss Marquis might be weaker than the other two marquises, but he was still an ancient marquis. He was no weakling.

After taking a glance at the ongoing battle, Fallen Star Marquis moved toward Great Zhou King. He could feel that Great Zhou King wasn’t teleporting over alone. But Fallen Star Marquis was confident that even if he couldn’t defeat them, he could still keep them occupied for quite a long while.

Hou Pseudo Emperor was the last to arrive. He intended to help Su Yu against Devilroil Marquis. One powerful aura after another erupted all over the Allheaven Battlefield. Initially, the Celestial Dragon Marquis intended to join the attack against the Human Realm. But upon further observation, he decided to head toward the Fate Realm instead.
Su Yu was the crux. And there was clearly no escape for Su Yu this time.
Heavendoom City.

The various ancient cities shook, and all the living beings in the cities trembled in fear. Yet another battle had erupted! Su Yu had actually taken the initiative to attack the Fate Realm. And it didn’t seem like things were going well for him.
Inside an ancient building.

The four Mountainseas suspected to be humans from the Upper Realm were gathered. they all looked incomparably solemn. One of them said, “Su Yu started the battle, but…this…this…is foolish! It’s over! With a defeat in the Lower Realm, the Upper Realm will…this…”
It was good that Su Yu had taken the initiative to start a battle.

As Great Zhou King said, these people were here to contact the humans of the Lower Realm and had them distract the myriad races to buy more time for those in the Upper Realm. But they never intended for the humans down here to stake everything in a war of extermination.
“Fool.”
“The gap in strength is too big. He is throwing his accumulated advantage into the drain.”
“Too arrogant. And too young.”

They were both furious and sorrowful. Their emotions were complicated. They did not want humanity to lose. They were also furious at Su Yu’s foolishness. But they were also filled with a certain degree of expectation. Just by killing a few myriad race Daofuses, the Upper Realm would be distracted from the human survivors up there.

In short, they hoped for victory, but they were also furious at Su Yu’s stupidity. How infuriating. They had just descended, and they were in the process of observation. They were still gathering information about the current human lord and sending the information back to the Upper Realm. That way, the old fossils up there would be able to make an informed decision on their next step.
Clearly, there was no longer any need for that. Su Yu was courting death.
“Sigh. Why didn’t Great Zhou King stop him? Great Zhou King should be a Torchbearer, right?”
“Probably.”
“We can’t stay here anymore. After their defeat, the ancient cities will probably be wiped out as well. We need to withdraw promptly.”
And thus, they reached the decision to withdraw rapidly.

Just then, a barrier appeared around the city. Tian He’s furious voice rang out, “Everyone, stay indoors. A curfew is in effect. Lord Heavendoom is on standby for battle. If you believe yourself superior to Lord Heavendoom, feel free to test us.”
With that, the four humans frowned. Even their path of escape had been severed. Heavendoom was the guardian in charge of this city. A ninth-degree Eternal. Someone they shouldn’t provoke easily.
They decided to continue keeping a low profile. They would think of what to do when the war arrived here.
